correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md interpolates (-1)^n D_n by restricted integral F(x)=sum (-1)^j falling_factorial(x,j). Interleaving parity in each mod 3^a class makes derangement image F(Z3) union -F(Z3). Coefficientwise F(3t)=1+6t mod9 gives a contraction bijection onto 1+3Z3 and its sign supplies all units. For x=1+3t, F=9A(t); the exact mod9 expansion and A'(t) congruent 2t mod3 give a unique critical point and p-adic Morse coordinate with image A(Z3)=c+Sq, v3(c)=2, c/9=2 mod3. Partition unit square classes and divisible arguments gives I_m and 725/972. Critically checked the actual falling-factorial polynomial reductions and normal-form steps, not only finite period logs. Independently enumerated D_n mod 3^a for a<=8 and signed shifted-square images m<=7: all match. Infinite conclusion relies on the complete analytic normal form.
correctness.residual_risks: Only p=3 derangement residues and distinct image cardinality, not index frequencies or any other prime; historical priority remains best-knowledge.
